title: Korah’s censers become altar plating
english: On [[Korah’s censers >> Bible:Numbers 16:36-40]], the people’s sedition against Moses, and the rods among which [[Aaron’s rod budded >> Bible:Numbers 17:8]]. With God nothing is useless or idle. He orders the sinners’ censers not thrown away but beaten into plating for the altar — a memorial that no outsider not of Aaron’s seed may draw near.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia VIII; Korah/Aaron rod CLOSEOUT.

title: Nothing useless with God
english: What humans would cast off still has necessary work with God. Even sins are turned into warning, so that memory of the fault may guard the holy things.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.

title: Aaron’s rod that budded
english: The twelve rods are set in the tent; Aaron’s rod put forth buds, flowers, and almonds. It prefigures the [[rod from the root of Jesse and the flower of Christ >> Bible:Isaiah 11:1]]. True priesthood blossoms in Christ. To whom be glory forever. Amen.
